items.name: Whole-Wheat Pasta with Zucchini Herbs
steps: Bring the water to a boil, add part of the rock salt, and cook the dry whole-wheat pasta until tender but intact.
Reserve a little cooking water, drain the pasta, and keep it warm.
Warm the olive oil and cook the diced zucchini with oregano until fully tender.
Fold in the pasta and fresh parsley, adding reserved water only as needed for a light sauce.
Adjust the remaining rock salt and serve warm.
items.guidance: Whole-Wheat Pasta with Zucchini Herbs uses a vegetable-forward sauce and a moderate pasta portion. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.
